title: Smear
description: A twenty-line poem in small white Arial on black arrives line by line, each word sliding in with a stutter of repeated copies trailing behind it. Drag across it and the words under your hand smear the way you pulled; hold to scatter the whole block and let go to watch it set again line by line.
intent: The lyric-edit motion smear as a material you can touch: every word keeps its own short history, and the trail is that history drawn back as discrete copies.
sources: herb reference board: cfcf1930 gif (poem on black with stuttered horizontal motion-smear settling into a block)
